value.syntax: # [doc = " A structure of the data language."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Every inhabitant has exactly one name ([`Value::to_canonical_bytes`]),"] # [doc = " and byte equality of names decides equality of structures."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The enum is exhaustive: its eleven variants are the closed set CBOR's"] # [doc = " major types define, and a `match` over the value model is meant to"] # [doc = " handle them completely."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " `Clone`, `PartialEq`, `Hash`, `Ord`, and `Drop` are hand-written rather"] # [doc = " than derived. A derived walk recurses to the nesting depth, so a value a"] # [doc = " hostile input nests deeply enough overflows the stack on the walk the"] # [doc = " compiler generates; each of these instead walks an explicit worklist, and"] # [doc = " the call depth stays constant however deep the value nested"] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-impl:xchg:iterative-teardown]´)."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::Value;"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let v = Value::integer(-500).expect(\"in range\");"] # [doc = " assert_eq!(v.to_canonical_bytes(), [0x39, 0x01, 0xf3]);"] # [doc = " assert_eq!(Value::from_canonical_bytes(&[0x39, 0x01, 0xf3]).expect(\"canonical\"), v);"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Eq)] pub enum Value { # [doc = " Major type 0: an integer in `[0, 2^64)`."] Unsigned (u64) , # [doc = " Major type 1: an integer in `[-2^64, -1]`."] Negative (Negative) , # [doc = " Major type 2."] Bytes (Bytes) , # [doc = " Major type 3, valid UTF-8 by construction."] Text (Text) , # [doc = " Major type 4."] Array (Array) , # [doc = " Major type 5, canonically ordered and duplicate-free by construction."] Map (Map) , # [doc = " Major type 6."] Tag (Tag) , # [doc = " Major type 7, simple values `false` and `true`."] Bool (bool) , # [doc = " Major type 7, simple value `null`."] Null , # [doc = " Major type 7, every other simple value — restrained."] Simple (Simple) , # [doc = " Major type 7, floating point — restrained."] Float (Float) , }
